**Release date:** August 2026

### Added
- **Version cards UI** â€” The updater now shows a card for each available version (up to 5), with individual Download and Install buttons per version.
- **Easy rollback** â€” Download and install any previous version directly from the updater. If a new version causes issues, roll back to a stable version with one click.
- **Auto-check on open** â€” The updater automatically checks for updates when you open the section. No more clicking "Check for Updates" manually.
- **Smooth UI** â€” No more blinking/flickering during update checks. Status badges show "Installed", "New", or "Older" for each version card.
- **Downloaded badge** â€” Already-downloaded versions show a blue "Downloaded" badge with an Install button.
